v.q: What is SLF4J?
o: A logging facade: an API that delegates to an implementation such as Logback or Log4j 2
A logging implementation that writes files itself
A log shipping agent for Kubernetes
v.w: Code uses the API and the implementation is chosen at deployment.

v.q: Which is the Spring Boot default logging implementation?
v.w: spring-boot-starter-logging brings Logback plus bridges.

v.q: The log shows 'Class path contains multiple SLF4J providers'. What does it mean?
o: Two implementations are on the classpath, so exclude one
SLF4J is too old to run
v.w: Use the dependency tree to find which library brought the second one.

v.q: Which setup creates a logging loop?
o: A bridge together with its opposite, for example log4j-over-slf4j with slf4j-log4j12
v.w: Each routes events to the other forever.

v.q: Which level fits 'a retry succeeded after the first attempt failed'?
v.w: A handled surprise: WARN. ERROR is for failures needing action.

v.q: A logger has no level of its own. How is its effective level decided?
o: It inherits the nearest ancestor's level, up to the root
v.w: com.bank.payments.X inherits from com.bank.payments, then com.bank, then root.

v.q: Why prefer log.debug("x {}", value) over log.debug("x " + value)?
o: The message is formatted only when DEBUG is enabled
Concatenation is not allowed in Java
Placeholders write to a different file
v.w: Concatenation builds the string even when the level is off.

v.q: An argument calls an expensive method. How do you avoid running it when DEBUG is off?
o: Use an isDebugEnabled guard, a supplier or the fluent API
v.w: Arguments are evaluated before the call, so placeholders alone do not help.

v.q: What is the correct way to log an exception?
o: log.error("Transfer {} failed", id, ex) with the exception last
v.w: The last argument is logged with its stack trace.

v.q: Why is log-and-rethrow an anti-pattern?
o: The same failure is logged again at every layer
v.w: Log once, where the error is finally handled.

v.q: Which settings stop log files from filling the disk?
o: A rolling policy with maxHistory and totalSizeCap
v.w: Roll by size and time, compress, and cap the total.

v.q: Why is logback-spring.xml preferred over logback.xml in Spring Boot?
o: It supports springProfile and springProperty and starts at the right time
It is faster at run time
It is the only name Logback reads
v.w: Boot processes it with its own extensions.

v.q: What is the trade-off of an async appender?
o: A bounded queue must block or discard when full, and queued events can be lost in a crash
v.w: Choose the full-queue policy deliberately.

v.q: What does Logback's AsyncAppender discard by default when the queue is 80 percent full?
v.w: Set discardingThreshold to 0 to keep everything.

v.q: What makes Log4j 2 async loggers fast?
o: A lock-free LMAX Disruptor ring buffer
v.w: Add com.lmax:disruptor and the async context selector.

v.q: Which is a feature Log4j 2 has that Logback does not?
v.w: Useful for latency-sensitive services.

v.q: How do you change a level in production without a restart in Spring Boot?
o: Restart with a new image only
v.w: Secure the endpoint and set it temporarily.

v.q: How do you reset a logger level set through Actuator?
v.w: The logger then inherits again.

v.q: What is the MDC?
o: A per-thread map of values that the layout prints on each line
v.w: Used for correlation IDs: %X{correlationId}.

v.q: Why is MDC.clear() called in a finally block?
o: Pooled threads are reused and would leak the previous request's data
v.w: Leaked context mislabels the next request's lines.

v.q: Work runs in an @Async method and its log lines have no correlation ID. Why?
o: MDC is a ThreadLocal, so the new thread starts with an empty context
v.w: Copy the MDC with a TaskDecorator or context propagation.

v.q: What does a TaskDecorator do for MDC?
o: Captures the caller's MDC and restores it on the pool thread for the task
v.w: It must also restore the thread's previous state afterwards.

v.q: What is the main benefit of JSON log lines?
o: Fields can be indexed and queried, and a stack trace stays in one event
v.w: One event per line, with fields.

v.q: In Kubernetes, where should a service write its logs?
o: To a file inside the container
v.w: The runtime and a collector take it from there.

v.q: Which value must never appear in a log line?
o: A full card number (PAN) or CVV
v.w: Log identifiers, not the sensitive data behind them.

v.q: What is the best protection against sensitive data in logs?
o: Mask at the source and exclude sensitive fields from toString and DTOs
Rely on a regex over the final text only
v.w: Defence in depth, with tests that assert masking.

v.q: What is log injection?
o: User input with line breaks forges extra log lines
v.w: JSON layouts escape the characters.

v.q: Which layout choice reduces log injection?
o: A JSON layout that escapes control characters
v.w: Text layouts need sanitising of logged user input.

v.q: Which versions did CVE-2021-44228 affect?
v.w: Fixed by upgrading to 2.17.1 or later.

v.q: Why was a default Spring Boot application not vulnerable?
o: It uses Logback, and the log4j-to-slf4j bridge has no log4j-core
v.w: Applications using starter-log4j2 or a bundled log4j-core jar were vulnerable.
